title: Eye of the Needle
author: Ken Follett
summary: In 1944, a ruthless German agent known as the Needle discovers the truth about the planned D-Day landings and tries to get the news home. British intelligence hunts him, and the chase ends on a remote island.
readIf: you like tightly paced Second World War spy thrillers.
skipIf: you want deep characterisation or a morally gentle story.
